sections.title: Leading Indicators & Safety Performance Metrics Log
sections.html:
Policy Summary: This form supports MISH 51 by capturing leading indicators that signal operational safety health before incidents occur.

Procedure Capture: Track Mission Brief completion, near-miss reporting, JHA completion, CAO closure performance, and training attendance in the Safety Dashboard and project records.

Task Use: Field Safety Leads complete entries by shift end and use the results to support quarterly executive review and corrective action prioritization.
